profile.headline: Technical Architect at ERCOT
profile.summary:
• 14 years of full life cycle software development experience
• Currently focused in enterprise application integration (EAI) using XML related technologies, web services and relational databases in a service oriented architecture (SOA) environment

Specialties: •  Real-time EAI software development using SOAP based web services
•  SOA architecture and infrastructure in a TIBCO environment using TIBCO EMS as the enterprise message bus
• Automated build & deployment architecture and infrastructure

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
 Software developer on a team of 6 developers Software development lead on a team of 3 developers
 Responsibilities included object-oriented design, development and testing of n-tier web applications and services including:  web applications in Microsoft ASP 3.0, COM objects in Microsoft Visual Basic 6.0, Microsoft SQL Server 2000 stored procedures in T-SQL, data migrations using SQL/Microsoft DTS and logical/physical data modeling
 The key technologies used were Microsoft ASP 3.0, JavaScript 1.5, HTML, Visual Basic 6.0, Microsoft COM, T-SQL and Microsoft SQL Server 2000

positions.title: Sr. Lead, Web Application Development
positions.description:
 Technical architecture design and implementation
 Application prototyping and development
 Tactically managing projects
 Serving as a liaison between the technical and business groups
 Developing business application vision with senior management
 Facilitating successful design and development of the technology
 Creation of technical business requirements and specifications

I managed web application development - led project activities, ensured technical integrity of the systems design and provided guidance for team members.  I was a supervisor/manager to four (4) software developers.  

My team was responsible for evaluating, designing, developing and testing web portal applications for the Prodigy 3.0 Portal which included configuring and maintaining development, staging and testing environments.  In addition, on-going maintenance of existing and new web portal applications on a highly scheduled maintenance/development release schedule.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
 Architect technical best practices in the following areas:  data modeling and software design and development
 Design and creation of the logical and physical data models, design prototyping, requirements gathering and full life cycle custom web development for e-commerce and ASP clients
 Conduct business requirements analysis and assessments for software package selection and custom software development
 Designed technical architecture, resolved technical implementation problems and application design, development and testing for custom software development
 Serving as a liaison between the technical and business groups

positions.title: Sr. Systems Analyst
positions.description:
 Applications prototyping and development (modification and creation)
 Technical infrastructure design and implementation
 Systems integration from legacy systems
 Custom end-user report generation
 Day-to-day project management of development team
 Evaluate and review development tools for national and regional IS staff
 Serving as a liaison between the technical and business groups

I was also responsible for the development teams career growth, daily work assignments, performance evaluations and project evaluation and reviews against existing and new project specifications.

positions.title: Information Technology Consultant
positions.description:
 Provided applications development support in PowerBuilder, accelerated systems development methodology and architecture and re-engineering methodology as applied to application design, prototyping and development
 Created technical infrastructure and business systems design and implementation specifications for applications development
 Enhanced, modified and developed an object-oriented accelerated applications development architecture in PowerBuilder

positions.title: Information Technology Consultant
positions.description:
 Conducted joint applications development sessions for requirements definition and functional evaluation and design
 Performed analysis, design and prototyping of a GUI system for a supply and demand driven registration system
 Created technical infrastructure and business systems design and implementation specifications for applications development and testing
